meta.title: Terms
meta.description: General terms and conditions of Moritz Hecht – Invessiv.

page.title: General Terms and Conditions
page.lead: These terms apply to services by Moritz Hecht – Invessiv related to website creation, optimization and digital process solutions.

scope.title: 2. Scope
scope.body: These terms apply to all offers, services, and contracts between Moritz Hecht – Invessiv and business customers unless otherwise agreed in writing. Information submitted through the project request is used for pre-contractual evaluation and offer preparation.

services.title: 3. Services
services.body: Type and scope of the services are defined by offer, scope description and project briefing. Scope changes require separate agreement.

payment.title: 4. Payment terms
payment.body: Prices follow the individual offer. Invoices are due within 14 days without deductions.

usageRights.title: 5. Usage rights
usageRights.body: Upon full payment, the client receives the agreed usage rights for delivered results within the contractually defined scope.
